module: Flowgraph node "Random Time of Day" (category repeat_instant, tags environment/tod/random). Picks a random time between two hours (0-23) and outputs it in the game format and as text. Inputs: fromHour (default 9), toHour (default 17), use24Hour (default false: 12 h AM/PM format). Outputs: time (0 to 1, where 0.5 = midnight, 0 = midday) and timeString ("HH:MM" or "H:MM AM/PM"). Handles the interval that crosses midnight (e.g. 22 to 2).
notes: A new random pick is made every frame the node receives flow (category repeat_instant); for a stable value, trigger it only once.

postInit.desc: Configures the integer 0-23 sliders of fromHour and toHour in the editor.

work.desc: Clamps the hours, picks a random time (handling the midnight crossing), computes hour/minute and writes time and timeString.
